svg.title: Writing a physical activity prescription: first check it is safe (absolute contraindications stop it; otherwise stratify cardiovascular risk to decide how to start), then write the dose with F.I.T.T., then tailor it for hypertension and blood pressure medications; adjust if pain or swelling follows

svg.text: Prescribe physical activity like a drug: is it SAFE, then what DOSE?

svg.text: ask: current activity · intentions · past activity + preferences · is it safe (symptoms, history)?
